Name: Astropy
Description: Community core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics, covering coordinates, time, units, tables, FITS, WCS, and common analysis utilities.

Name: healpy
Description: Python package for handling HEALPix pixelated maps on the sphere, used for CMB and all-sky astrophysics analysis.

Name: Photutils
Description: Astropy coordinated package for source detection and photometry on astronomical imagery, including aperture and PSF photometry, segmentation, and background estimation.

Name: CAMB
Description: Code for Anisotropies in the Microwave Background; computes CMB, lensing, matter power spectra, transfer functions, and background cosmology.

Name: PySM
Description: Python Sky Model package for full-sky simulations of Galactic emission and polarization relevant to CMB experiments.

Name: MontePython
Description: Monte Carlo Markov Chain code for cosmological parameter inference, with likelihood tooling and CLASS integration.

Name: SWIFT
Description: Modern astrophysics and cosmology particle-based simulation code for gravity, hydrodynamics, and large-scale simulations.

Name: RAMSES
Description: Adaptive mesh refinement code for astrophysical systems, self-gravity, magnetised fluid flows, radiation, and cosmological simulations.

Name: Takefits
Description: Desktop FITS viewer and analysis tool for radio astronomy, with synchronized cube views, moment maps and spectral extraction.

Name: MAST
Description: Archive for space-based astronomical observations, including Hubble, JWST, Kepler and TESS data, with discovery and access services.

Name: IVOA ObsCore
Description: Core observation metadata model for interoperable discovery of astronomical datasets; commonly exposed through ObsTAP services.

Name: Jdaviz
Description: Interactive visualization and analysis of astronomical images, spectra and spectral cubes, with linked selections and notebook APIs.

Name: Lightkurve
Description: Python package for accessing and analysing Kepler, K2 and TESS light curves and pixel data, including photometry, detrending and period searches.

Name: PySPEDAS
Description: Python tools for loading and analysing space-physics observations, including plasma, magnetic fields and waves from multiple missions.

Name: Gammapy
Description: Python package for gamma-ray astronomy analysis using reconstructed events and instrument responses, including maps, spectra and likelihood-based modelling.

Name: LSDB
Description: Python library for scalable analysis and crossmatching of astronomical catalogues using HATS spatial partitions and Dask; boundary matching requires appropriate margin data.

Name: Aladin Lite
Description: Embeddable sky viewer for astronomical image surveys, FITS images and catalogue overlays, controlled through a JavaScript API.

Name: Ginga
Description: Python toolkit for building astronomical FITS viewers, with reusable image widgets, overlays and a plugin-based desktop viewer.

Name: APLpy
Description: Python library for publication-quality plots of astronomical FITS images with celestial coordinate axes and overlays.

Name: glue
Description: Python framework for linked views of images, tables and data cubes, with shared selections and extensible viewers.

Name: Firefly
Description: Reusable web components for exploring astronomical images, catalogues and spectra, with linked selections and archive query interfaces.

Name: Open Exoplanet Catalogue
Description: Community-maintained catalogue of exoplanets and their host systems, with physical and orbital parameters stored in openly licensed XML files.

Name: JS9
Description: Embeddable browser viewer for astronomical FITS images, tables and data cubes, with scripting and analysis APIs.
Comment: No active maintainer; development ended in 2022.
